description: Source code for Kubernetes ServiceAccount admission plugin, handling default service account assignment, secret reference validation, and mounting service account tokens in pods.

classes.name: Plugin
classes.description: Admission plugin for managing service accounts, secret references, and token mounting in pods.

methods.name: NewServiceAccount
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the service account admission plugin with default settings.

methods.name: SetExternalKubeClientSet
methods.description: Sets the Kubernetes client for the plugin.

methods.name: ValidateInitialization
methods.description: Validates that the plugin has been properly initialized with required dependencies.

methods.name: Admit
methods.description: Main admission logic for pods, setting defaults and mounting tokens.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates pod specifications, especially for mirror pods and secret references.

methods.name: enforceMountableSecrets
methods.description: Determines if mountable secrets should be enforced for a service account.

methods.name: getServiceAccount
methods.description: Retrieves a service account from cache or API server.

methods.name: limitSecretReferences
methods.description: Checks if pod secret references are allowed by the service account.

methods.name: limitEphemeralContainerSecretReferences
methods.description: Checks secret references in ephemeral containers.

methods.name: mountServiceAccountToken
methods.description: Mounts the service account token into the pod's containers.

methods.name: TokenVolumeSource
methods.description: Returns the projected volume source for service account tokens.
